headline: Different T-Shirt Printing Techniques: A Complete Guide for Businesses
description: If you run a business, sooner or later you will need printed T-shirts. Maybe it is a uniform for your staff, merchandise for a launch, gifts for a corporate event, or a small clothing line of your own. And the moment you start asking for quotes, you run into a confusing list: screen printing, DTF, DTG, heat transfer, sublimation, vinyl, embroidery. Every printer swears by a different one, which makes choosing between T-shirt printing techniques harder than it should be.
